query: SELECT COUNT(*)=$1::bigint AS "completed!" FROM UNNEST($2::text[]) candidate(id) JOIN "Document" d ON d.id=candidate.id AND d."deletedAt" IS NULL AND d."projectId" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $3 JOIN document_sub_type dst ON dst.document_id=d.id AND dst.sub_type='task' JOIN entity_properties ep ON ep.entity_id=d.id AND ep.entity_type='TASK' AND ep.property_definition_id=$4 AND ep.values=jsonb_build_object('type','SelectOption','value',jsonb_build_array($5::text))
